items.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a country's collective naval force, with which it can perform ⟦1⟧.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧是一个国家的海上武装力量，可用于执行⟦1⟧。

items.en: For organization and control, the navy is divided into one or more ⟦0⟧. Each fleet consists of one or more ⟦1⟧, with each task force containing a number of individual ⟦2⟧.
items.zh: 为便于组织与指挥，海军被划分为一个或多个⟦0⟧。每支舰队由一个或多个⟦1⟧组成，而每支特遣舰队则包含若干艘单独的⟦2⟧。

items.en: To maintain the current composition even after a task force takes losses, the ⟦0⟧ option can be enabled. This will reinforce the task force with ships from the theater's ⟦1⟧.
items.zh: 为使特遣舰队在遭受损失后仍保持当前编成，可以启用⟦0⟧选项。这会用所属战区的⟦1⟧中的舰船补充该特遣舰队。

items.en: ⟦0⟧: Allows the most heavily damaged ships to detach and return to a close by naval base for repairs while the rest of the task force continues its mission. The detached ships are very vulnerable to attack while they return. After completing repairs, the ships will return to their assigned task forces. The amount of ships detached depends on the repair priority setting as well as the damage to each individual ship.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧：允许受损最重的舰船脱离编队，返回附近的海军基地修理，而特遣舰队的其余舰船继续执行任务。脱离的舰船在返航途中极易遭到攻击。修理完成后，这些舰船会返回其原属的特遣舰队。脱离的舰船数量取决于修理优先级的设置以及每艘舰船各自的受损程度。

items.en: ⟦0⟧: Sets how severely a task force has to be damaged before it returns for repairs.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧：设定特遣舰队受损到什么程度才会返回修理。

items.en: ⟦0⟧: Explicitly orders an individual ship to return to port as a detached task force for repairs. Shift-clicking on the button will allow multiple damaged ships to be detached as one task force.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧：明确命令单艘舰船作为独立特遣舰队返回港口修理。按住 Shift 点击该按钮，可将多艘受损舰船作为一支特遣舰队一并脱离。

items.en: A ⟦0⟧ is a group of one or more task forces. Each fleet has its own insignia and name, which can be customized by the player.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧是一支或多支特遣舰队组成的群体。每支舰队都有自己的徽章与名称，玩家可以自行定制。

items.en: An ⟦0⟧ can be assigned to each fleet, conferring bonuses to all task forces within the fleet.
items.zh: 可以为每支舰队指派一名⟦0⟧，为该舰队内的所有特遣舰队提供加成。

items.en: When task force(s) within a fleet are selected, ⟦0⟧ the task forces have been assigned to a ⟦1⟧, the fleet as a whole can then be assigned to specific ⟦2⟧ by right-clicking regions on the map. This determines where the task forces of the fleet may be automatically distributed when performing their mission.
items.zh: 选中舰队中的特遣舰队后，⟦0⟧已为这些特遣舰队指派了⟦1⟧，即可通过在地图上右键点击区域，把整支舰队指派到特定的⟦2⟧。这决定了该舰队的特遣舰队在执行任务时可以自动分布到哪些地方。

items.en: Each fleet is part of a named naval ⟦0⟧, which is simply a group of fleets. A theater can accommodate any number of fleets without penalty. There is always a minimum of one theater, but the player may create additional theaters if desired.
items.zh: 每支舰队都属于一个具名的海军⟦0⟧，而战区无非是一组舰队。一个战区可以容纳任意数量的舰队而不会受到惩罚。战区始终至少有一个，但玩家可以根据需要创建更多战区。

items.en: The ⟦0⟧ of each theater can be set to 'normal' or 'high'. When set to 'high', alerts from the theater (e.g. ⟦1⟧ in progress) will appear prominently alongside other global alerts.
items.zh: 每个战区的⟦0⟧可以设为「普通」或「高」。设为「高」时，来自该战区的警报（例如正在进行⟦1⟧）会与其他全局警报一同醒目地显示。

items.en: Each theater has a ⟦0⟧. Unlike normal fleets, the reserve fleet may be empty. The reserve fleet accommodates any task forces which are not yet assigned to a normal fleet. If left in the reserve fleet, these ships may be used for ⟦1⟧ of task forces which have been configured for this.
items.zh: 每个战区都有一个⟦0⟧。与普通舰队不同，预备舰队可以是空的。预备舰队容纳尚未编入普通舰队的任何特遣舰队。若这些舰船留在预备舰队中，它们可用于已为此配置的⟦1⟧。

items.en: The ⟦0⟧ screen can be opened by pressing the ⟦1⟧ hotkey or clicking on the navy icon in the top right corner of the screen. This will bring up a summary of the country's naval forces currently deployed, as well as the values of some naval-related modifiers.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧界面可以通过按下⟦1⟧快捷键打开，也可以点击屏幕右上角的海军图标。界面中会显示该国当前已部署海军力量的汇总，以及若干海军相关修正的数值。

items.en: ⟦0⟧ will open a window that shows a list of ships that have been sunk, either of or by the country, in the last two years.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧会打开一个窗口，列出该国在过去两年中击沉或损失的所有舰船。

items.en: ⟦0⟧ shows the current number of ships by type and class.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧会按舰种与舰级显示当前的舰船数量。

items.en: The ⟦0⟧ status (abbreviated as PotF) can be assigned to a single capital ship in the nation's navy. Having one provides the nation with ⟦1⟧ 战争支持度. The ship itself also gains a ⟦2⟧ bonus versus critical hits and a ⟦3⟧ bonus to experience gain, and is less prone to accidents.⟦4⟧ Most major countries start with a PotF already, but the status can be reassigned at any time for 100⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧. Countries that do not start with a PotF can assign one for no cost should they obtain a capital ship.
items.zh: ⟦0⟧状态（缩写为 PotF）可以指派给该国海军中的一艘主力舰。拥有一艘可为国家提供⟦1⟧战争支持度。该舰自身还会获得⟦2⟧的受致命一击概率加成与⟦3⟧的经验获取加成，并且更不容易发生事故。⟦4⟧ 大多数主要国家开局就已拥有舰队之傲，但该状态随时可以花费 100⟦5⟧ ⟦6⟧重新指派。开局没有舰队之傲的国家，在获得主力舰时可以免费指派一艘。

items.en: If a PotF is lost to the enemy, in incurs a ⟦0⟧ war support penalty for 30⟦1⟧ days. A new PotF can be assigned for the same 100 ⟦2⟧ cost as when reassigning the PotF role.
items.zh: 如果舰队之傲被敌方击沉，会带来⟦0⟧的战争支持度惩罚，持续 30⟦1⟧天。重新指派新的舰队之傲需要花费与重新指派舰队之傲职务相同的 100 ⟦2⟧。
